t: Audit settings.local.json at closeout for session artifacts vs permanent permissions
challenge: settings.local.json accumulates session-specific junk over time: broken shell fragments, encoded commands, paths to unrelated projects, retired file references. Claude Code appends new permissions on each approval without deduplication or cleanup.
hypothesis: Add an audit step to closeout (or periodic hygiene check): scan settings.local.json for entries that look like session artifacts (broken fragments, project-specific paths, retired references) vs permanent permissions. Flag artifacts for user review and removal.
next_step: add optional hygiene step to wai-closeout.md; define artifact detection heuristics

_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: An instruction to implement immediately without user direction.
